hero.html:
Level 3 - Intermediate 45 min HLD APIs

API Design & Client-Server Communication

After this page you can write a clean API for any design question in five minutes, pick REST, gRPC or GraphQL with a reason, paginate correctly, make retries safe with idempotency keys, and choose between polling, SSE, WebSockets, webhooks and WebRTC without over-engineering.
